claims.claim_ar: الجمع بين الترغيب والترهيب (التحفيز بالإنفاق مع الإنذار بيوم لا نفع فيه) كأسلوب بلاغي لتشجيع الطاعة وتثبيط الإهمال.
claims.claim_en: The pairing of encouragement and warning (urging spending while warning of a day when it will be of no avail) — a rhetorical method that motivates obedience and deters negligence.
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided source chunk explicitly names the general method 'الترغيب مع الترهيب' (supports the claim), but the chunk is a general statement about Qur'anic style rather than a commentary quoting this specific āyah; linkage to this exact verse should be confirmed with verse-specific commentary.

claims.claim_ar: تكرار نافية ‹وَلَا› ثلاث مرّات (لَا بَيْعٌ فِيهِ وَلا خُلَّةٌ وَلا شَفَاعَةٌ) لتكثيف النفي وإحكام الحصر ورفع حجة الإنذار.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the negative particle 'wa-la' three times (Lā bay‘un fīhi wa-lā khulla wa-lā shafā‘ah) to intensify the negation, enforce exclusivity, and strengthen the warning.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited chunk discusses the coordinating waw (الواو) as a connective; it supports the observation that conjunctions join items. However the commentary quoted is general (on conjunction) rather than an explicit rhetorical analysis of the triple negation in this verse — recommend confirming with verse-specific exegesis for nuance (e.g., rhetorical effect of the triple negation).
